packages.reason: The single bechina of Torah #178 is the identity of nefesh (soul) with dibur (speech): 'וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הוּא בְּחִינַת הַדִּבּוּר, בִּבְחִינַת נַפְשִׁי יָצְאָה בְדַבְּרוֹ.' This is the theological foundation of the entire Torah: because the soul IS speech, the damage of sin is located in speech, and therefore verbal confession (viduy devarim) is precisely the repair mechanism for the nefesh. Both nodes are expressions of the same spiritual reality — the innermost voice of a person. This is a positive (good) package because the Torah is teaching the path of repair through confession: the nefesh-as-dibur IS the sacred domain that can be restored through holy speech. The nefesh here is not damaged or evil; it is the holy vessel that needs healing, and dibur is the means of that healing because they share the same essential nature.
